citation.authors: Evang EC, Habte TY, Owino WO, Krawinkel MB

cited_by.title: Baobab fruit: blood sugar, iron and vitamin C

record.population: 58 Kenyan schoolchildren aged 6 to 12 with haemoglobin below 12.2 g/dl
record.design: Single-blind randomised trial: a drink with baobab fruit pulp or an equal-energy drink daily for 12 weeks
record.finding: Haemoglobin, ferritin and soluble transferrin receptor did not differ significantly between the groups. Haemoglobin rose 2.2% with baobab and fell 1.2% in the control group, a difference the authors did not find significant.
record.note: Small, in children, for iron status; the authors suggest the pulp's vitamin C could still help iron absorption.
